harnesses.title: SF Data 360 action sweep

harnesses.artifacts: JSON and Markdown reports in a temporary or caller-selected directory

harnesses.title: SF Data 360 private fixture discovery
harnesses.summary: Discovers bounded org-local identifiers for recursive sf_data360 reads without committing target-specific values.
harnesses.target: Explicit non-production org
harnesses.artifacts: Mode-0o600 JSON fixture profile at the caller-selected path

harnesses.title: Data 360 STDM transport smoke
harnesses.summary: Exercises metadata, readiness, safety, and bounded observability query Modules.
harnesses.target: Explicit non-production org
harnesses.artifacts: Console proof only

harnesses.title: Agent Platform tracing smoke
harnesses.summary: Reads tracing metadata and bounded spans, then reconstructs a trace tree locally.
harnesses.target: Explicit non-production org
harnesses.artifacts: Console proof only

harnesses.title: SF Apex lifecycle harness
harnesses.summary: Exercises native discovery, traces, logs, Anonymous Apex, tests, and coverage against a deployed fixture.
harnesses.target: Explicit dedicated non-production org and harness project
harnesses.artifacts: Session-scoped Apex source, log, test, and coverage artifacts

harnesses.title: SF Browser navigation hardening
harnesses.summary: Verifies curated destinations, structured routes, and closed-loop Salesforce Setup/App Launcher navigation through a live headless browser.
harnesses.target: Explicit non-production org
harnesses.artifacts: Browser Evidence screenshots plus Markdown and HTML reports

harnesses.title: SF Integrate Headless 360 OAuth lifecycle
harnesses.summary: Proves explicit-org preflight, source-bound External Client App planning, Metadata API check-only validation, and optional disposable create/read/delete verification for the Headless 360 MCP preset.
harnesses.target: Explicit non-production org with External Client App metadata support
harnesses.artifacts: Mode-0600 integration plan, deployment, verification, and handoff artifacts

harnesses.title: SF Integrate External Client App OAuth matrix
harnesses.summary: Check-only validates the core ECA OAuth profiles and optionally creates, reads back, performs bounded flow handshakes, and cleans up Authorization Code, PKCE, Client Credentials, Device, JWT Bearer, and Token Exchange apps.
harnesses.target: Explicit non-production org with External Client App metadata support and OpenSSL
harnesses.artifacts: Mode-0600 ECA profile plans and deployment/verification evidence

harnesses.title: SF Integrate outbound credential lifecycle
harnesses.summary: Proves plan-bound OAuth or API-key setup, optional External Credential check-only validation, disposable Named Credential stack creation, secret-safe credential population, principal access, OAuth consent URL generation or bounded GET callout, and cleanup.
harnesses.target: Explicit non-production org with modern Named Credentials and outbound callout access
harnesses.artifacts: Mode-0600 outbound plan, setup, verification, and Anonymous Apex probe artifacts

harnesses.title: SF Flow lifecycle harness
harnesses.summary: Exercises local diagnosis, org preflight, one-file Metadata API check-only validation, Flow test discovery, and optional targeted Flow tests.
harnesses.target: Explicit non-production org and workspace-contained Flow file
harnesses.artifacts: Session-scoped Flow diagnostics, topology, validation, and optional test reports

harnesses.title: SF Flow advanced runtime sweep
harnesses.summary: Proves record trigger variants, typed entry criteria, immediate/related/async paths, a 200-record async-after-commit fan-out, a 201-record schedule batch without partition assertions, explicit and unspecified trigger order, nested subflow propagation and rollback, real faults, related deletion, record collections, Create Records upsert with partial/all-or-none behavior, multi-field/null ordering, Transform joins/aggregation/nested collections, committed Wait resume, Apex and standard actions, prior values, bulk execution, collection processors, and Subflow contracts across headless Flow families; Roll Back Records remains a separate Screen runtime proof.
harnesses.target: Explicit dedicated non-production org with API 67.0 or later
harnesses.artifacts: Metadata API validation/deployment evidence plus targeted Apex test and cleanup outcomes

harnesses.title: SF Flow live action sweep
harnesses.summary: Proves complex Invocable Apex, Named Credential-backed Apex, OpenAPI External Service, object-specific Quick Action, workflow Email Alert, and dynamically grounded Run Agent actions through live Flow execution.
harnesses.target: Explicit dedicated non-production org with API 67.0, outbound callout access, and at least one callable Agentforce action
harnesses.artifacts: Metadata API validation/deployment, targeted Apex tests, live action outputs, and cleanup evidence

harnesses.title: SF Flow first-class lifecycle sweep
harnesses.summary: Proves canonical lifecycle status, local-file check/deploy/activation without source mutation, exact existing-version activation, and deterministic deactivation through the production sf_flow lifecycle implementation.
harnesses.target: Explicit dedicated non-production org with the SF Flow action fixture already installed
harnesses.artifacts: Session-scoped Flow lifecycle check-only, deployment, and resulting-state artifacts

harnesses.title: SF Flow core-family sweep
harnesses.summary: Diagnoses and check-only validates all core Flow family fixtures, then optionally deploys them as Draft, enforces FlowDefinition deactivation cleanup, runs the non-committing after-save FlowTest twice, and verifies no jobs or records remain.
harnesses.target: Explicit non-production org with FlowTest and platform-event support
harnesses.artifacts: Session-scoped diagnostics, topology, Flow test reports, and Metadata API console evidence

harnesses.title: SF Flow test-fixture provisioning
harnesses.summary: Check-only validates and optionally deploys a dedicated public-safe autolaunched Flow plus FlowTest fixture.
harnesses.target: Explicit non-production org with FlowTest support
harnesses.artifacts: Metadata API validation/deployment console evidence

harnesses.title: SF Herdr disposable-pane smoke
harnesses.summary: Splits a fresh pane, runs a harmless marker, verifies output, and closes only after success.
harnesses.target: Disposable Herdr session with SF_HERDR_LIVE_SMOKE=1
harnesses.artifacts: Console proof; failed panes remain open for inspection

harnesses.title: SF LWC local lifecycle harness
harnesses.summary: Builds a temporary SFDX fixture and exercises scan, inspect, diagnostics, planning, and Jest execution.
harnesses.target: Generated local workspace; no org
harnesses.artifacts: Temporary project plus LWC diagnostic and Jest artifacts

harnesses.title: SF MCP Salesforce DX live smoke

harnesses.target: Explicit authorized Salesforce org and explicit Pi model
harnesses.artifacts: Redacted JSON and Markdown reports in a temporary or caller-selected directory

harnesses.title: SF MCP Salesforce DX contract canary
harnesses.summary: Resolves one exact Salesforce MCP package version, captures the normalized Pi runtime tool contract without invoking an org tool, and compares it with the reviewed public-safe baseline.
harnesses.target: npm registry plus an explicit locally authorized Salesforce org for server startup
harnesses.artifacts: Public-safe candidate, drift, and Markdown reports in a temporary or caller-selected directory

harnesses.title: SF SOQL lifecycle harness
harnesses.summary: Exercises schema, validation, bounded query, SOSL, file, history, and export behavior.
harnesses.target: Explicit non-production org
harnesses.artifacts: Temporary query files plus session-scoped query and export artifacts

harnesses.title: Instruction behavior regression

harnesses.target: Explicit model or configured default
harnesses.artifacts: JSON and Markdown reports under .pi/state/sf-brain/instruction-behavior/
